# Professional Profile

```{=html}
<section class="cv-hero swiss-reveal">
  <div class="cv-hero-copy">
    <div class="cv-kicker">Biomedical &amp; Electrical Engineering</div>
    <div class="cv-hero-statement">I build and integrate engineering systems for biomedical research, medical devices and experimental platforms.</div>
    <p>My background combines <strong>biomedical engineering, electronics, embedded systems, instrumentation, biomedical optics, robotics, FPGA and experimental validation</strong>. I am especially motivated by problems where hardware, software and physiology need to work as one system.</p>
    <p>I work with an implementation-oriented mindset: define the need, translate it into measurable requirements, build the system, calibrate it, test it and iterate from data.</p>
  </div>
```

# Research & Development

```{=html}
<section class="cv-card-grid swiss-reveal">
  <article class="cv-card with-button">
    <span class="cv-card-icon cv-icon-flask" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="cv-card-label">Main research line</div>
    <h3>Master’s Research — Liver Viability &amp; ICG-NIR</h3>
    <p>Development of an <strong>ex vivo liver perfusion platform</strong> and investigation of <strong>ICG-NIR kinetics</strong> to explore quantitative indicators of liver function and viability.</p>
    <div class="cv-card-tags">
      <span>Ex vivo perfusion</span><span>Monitoring</span><span>ICG-NIR</span><span>Validation</span>
    </div>
    <a class="project-page-button" href="projects/thesis.html">View project detail</a>
  </article>

  <article class="cv-card with-button">
    <span class="cv-card-icon cv-icon-snow" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="cv-card-label">Preservation research</div>
    <h3>Borealis UC — Organ Supercooling</h3>
    <p>Research participation in organ preservation, focused on <strong>supercooling strategies</strong>, thermal control and experimental support.</p>
    <div class="cv-card-tags">
      <span>Organ preservation</span><span>Thermal control</span><span>Research support</span>
    </div>
    <a class="project-page-button" href="projects/borealis.html">View project detail</a>
  </article>

  <article class="cv-card with-button">
    <span class="cv-card-icon cv-icon-heart-pulse" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="cv-card-label">Device development</div>
    <h3>Organ Preservation Machine</h3>
    <p>Electromechanical redesign of an organ preservation system, integrating <strong>fluidics, control and miniaturization</strong>.</p>
    <div class="cv-card-tags">
      <span>Mechanics</span><span>Fluid system</span><span>Control</span>
    </div>
    <a class="project-page-button" href="projects/organ-preservation.html">View project detail</a>
  </article>

  <article class="cv-card">
    <span class="cv-card-icon cv-icon-chart" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="cv-card-label">Engineering method</div>
    <h3>Typical workflow</h3>
    <p>Problem definition → measurable requirements → architecture → implementation → calibration → testing → lessons learned.</p>
    <p>This same structure organizes my portfolio and guides how I approach technical development.</p>
  </article>
</section>
```
